definition: A rating system, originally developed for chess, adapted to rank AI models based on the outcomes of pairwise comparisons between their outputs.
details: Elo ratings are used in platforms like Chatbot Arena to rank language models based on aggregated human preference votes from many pairwise 'battles' between model outputs.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Elo Rating (for model comparison).
